entries.message: Task 2: Check the database connection in /healthz with a 2-second timeout
entries.output:
`/healthz` now pings the connection pool with `PingContext` under a
2-second deadline of its own. A hung database fails the check after two
seconds instead of holding the probe open.

Added a unit test with a stub pool that never answers.

entries.output:

`GET /healthz`. It answers 200 with `{"version": …, "uptime_seconds": …}`;
the version comes from the build info the binary already embeds.

`go test ./internal/health/` passes.
